title: Chapter 3
text: “[A] DEFT SCIENTIFIC THRILLER … A SNAPPY NIGHTMARE OF SCIENCE RUN AMOK.” — The Wall Street Journal “Crichton’s dinosaurs are genuinely frightening.” — Chicago Sun-Times “Crichton’s sci-fi is convincingly detailed.” — Time Magazine “Vastly entertaining … [A] tornado-paced tale … Easily the most exciting dinosaur novel ever written. A sure-fire bestseller.” — Kirkus Reviews “A scary, creepy, mesmerizing techno-thriller with teeth.” — Publishers Weekly “By far the best science fiction I have read since Jules Verne in my youth.” — John Barkham Review
